hotspots.title: AfD’s internal leadership battles intensify
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces escalating internal conflicts, with courts allowing stricter surveillance of its Lower Saxony branch due to anti-constitutional activities. The party’s election programs in multiple states advocate controversial policies like nuclear energy revival and anti-immigration measures, while its leadership is increasingly scrutinized for extremist ties.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the high stakes of AfD’s potential governance in upcoming state elections, its polarizing policies, and the moral panic over its extremist associations.

hotspots.title: Colombia’s far-right presidential runoff sparks global right-wing celebration
hotspots.blurb: Far-right candidate Abelardo de la Espriella’s first-round victory in Colombia’s presidential election has triggered celebrations among global right-wing figures, including Argentina’s Javier Milei and Spain’s Vox. The runoff against leftist Iván Cepeda is framed as a pivotal ideological battle, with international right-wing leaders rallying behind de la Espriella’s anti-socialist platform.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the high-stakes ideological confrontation, cross-border right-wing solidarity, and the framing of the election as a global litmus test for anti-socialist movements.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and economic policies under scrutiny
hotspots.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces mounting criticism over his economic policies, including austerity measures and labor reforms, which have led to declining wages and social unrest. His administration is also embroiled in corruption scandals, such as the Adorni case, and internal power struggles, while his international alliances with figures like Peter Thiel and far-right leaders draw both praise and condemnation.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is highly charged due to the stark contrast between Milei’s triumphalist economic rhetoric and the harsh realities of inflation, wage cuts, and social backlash, alongside moral outrage over corruption allegations.

hotspots.title: Trump’s Iran deal negotiations dominate coverage
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump’s negotiations with Iran over a potential peace deal have dominated right-wing and far-right coverage, with intense speculation over the terms and implications. The proposed deal, which includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz and easing sanctions, has divided Republicans, with some hawks opposing it as too lenient and others supporting it as a pragmatic solution.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is highly charged due to the high-stakes geopolitical implications, the polarized contention within the Republican Party, and the moral framing of the deal as either a triumph or a betrayal of U.S. interests.
